aboutMore: ok second paragraph bc ppl keep asking what else i do. first saturday of every month i work the serving line at the soup kitchen on 4th street (hairnet, apron that says KISS THE COOK, which is not my fault). i also drive the church van, Big Moses (he parts traffic), a 15 passenger Ford with a tape deck that ate a Newsboys cassette before i even had my license and now plays side A only. forever. my little sister abby is 12 and thinks im 'mildly famous' bc strangers say hi to me at kroger. (theyre from the van.) i can parallel park Moses on the first try. its the only thing i do on the first try =]

blog.title: first saturdays at the soup kitchen (mr delmar rates the gravy)
blog.body: ok so every first saturday im on the serving line on 4th street from 9 to 1. i do potatoes. theres a guy who comes in every month named mr delmar, hes like 74, retired off the railroad, hat that says CSX that hes had since before i was born. he sits at the same table, eats everything, and then rates the gravy out of 10 out loud to nobody. its been a 6 since june. today i asked him what would make it a 7 and he said 'salt, son. and less talking.' so i stopped talking and he beat me at checkers in 11 minutes. thats 11 straight. he plays on a board somebody drew on a pizza box. when i left he said 'you listen good, most boys your age just wait for their turn to talk.' i think that was the nicest thing anyone has said to me all week. he also took 2 rolls for the road and told me not to tell the lady in the hairnet. (she knows. she packs him 3.) anyway the gravy is a 6. i think a 6 is a compliment.

blog.title: how to park a 15 passenger van: a guide by someone who has done it exactly once correctly
blog.body: step 1: dont look at the van. look at the SPACE. the van is 9 feet tall and 22 feet long and knows it. step 2: pull up even w/ the car in front, wheel hard right, and say 'moses' out loud. this does nothing but it feels right. (he parts traffic. thats the joke.) step 3: pastor dan sits in the passenger seat and says 'youve got room' every 4 seconds. you do not have room. do not tell him. step 4: use the side mirrors, not the back one, bc the back window has a lock-in sticker on it from last spring and nobody has found the scraper. step 5: when the kids in the back start yelling 'STOP' they are not talking about the curb, they are talking about chad, who is narrating. ignore chad. step 6: straighten out. u will be 3 inches from the curb. thats a win. u will be 3 inches from the car behind u. thats ALSO a win. step 7: turn off the engine and sit there for a second like a guy in a movie. then pastor dan says 'good thing we parked it, theres a tape stuck in the deck' and it plays side A of the Newsboys again.

blog.title: i lost at halo to a 9 year old and his mom said thank you
blog.body: so last night on lockout i get matched with a kid on the other team named xX_Pwnage_Xx with a mic and a voice like a kazoo. he is NOT quiet. he is saying 'camper' at me the whole time and i havent camped once, i dont camp, its a point of pride. he beats me 50 to 41. i say 'gg dude nice shot' and theres a pause and then a grown woman's voice goes 'oh my gosh, hi, this is his mom, he's nine, i just want to say thank you for being so nice to him, usually somebody says something we have to mute.' and then in the background the kid goes 'MOM IM IN A MATCH' and she says 'dinner is in four minutes.' i said no problem ma'am. he was soooo good. he got a double kill with a plasma pistol. i wanna say this out loud: a fourth grader got me and i would do it again. also he friend requested me. hes in my friends list now. i dont know what to do with that. we r going to play wednesday at 5, before dinner.

blog.title: who do i vent to (not a complaint)
blog.body: this week on aim: lexi x3 (nate), nate x2 (lexi), kayla x1 (bryan, 2 hrs), chad x1 (how do i make the font smaller), dave x1 (for hacking purposes, he wanted my gamertag AGAIN), a kid from youth group whose dog died, and a guy named todd who needed to know if you can restart a website by turning it off and on. thats 11 convos. i like it. i do. i dont say that to be nice, its the best part of my day. but sunday night at like 12:30 i was just sitting there w/ the lights off and i realized i dont know who i would aim if i needed to. which is fine!! im not sad about it. just noticing. then abby (12) knocked on my door bc she said the typing sounded 'sad' (it was regular typing) and she sat down on my floor with her math homework and didnt say anything for an hour. she just did fractions at me. that was the whole thing. thats all i needed. anyway if u ask me how im doing ill say 'good' and then eventually ill say the real thing. im on aim till 11. fractions are fine.
